verdict.rationale: Vercel's marketplace lists Neon as a serverless Postgres option with autoscaling, which could satisfy 'no connection management,' but this is a third-party integration mentioned in a single one-line blurb with no detail on how connection pooling, driver setup, or querying-from-code actually works without connection management on Vercel's platform. missing for 10: first-party docs on Vercel's own serverless SQL storage (e.g. connection pooling/driver-less query API), code examples showing querying with no connection management, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
